title: Neural Conversation Models and How to Rein Them in: A Survey of Failures and Fixes

bias_targets.methodology: The paper surveys existing literature on how neural conversation models violate social norms by generating offensive language, agreeing with harmful statements, or providing unsafe advice. It reviews evaluation and mitigation methodologies used in the field, such as measuring the frequency of toxic tokens in generated text, conducting human evaluations of model toxicity, and using self-diagnosis classifiers during decoding.
